_comment: Arbitrum One (42161) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Every address below was verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) on 2026-09-08. Two entries may share one `symbol` — native ETH and WETH both price off ETH/USD. WBTC uses the WBTC/USD feed (tracks the wrapper, heartbeat 86400) rather than BTC/USD (heartbeat 1755) — switch the symbol to "BTC" if you prefer the tighter heartbeat over wrapper-aware pricing. USDC.e is bridged USDC and USD₮0 is the OFT USDT; both ride the base asset's feed. Feeds present but not wired: BTC, and SOL/BNB/XRP/ADA/AVAX/DOGE/LTC/DOT/POL/OP, which have no canonical ERC-20 here. Wrapped/bridged representations ride the base asset's feed: a depeg of the wrapper itself is outside what the oracle can see. That is the same trade-off already taken for WBTC on chains with no WBTC/USD feed.
